findings.rationale: When --pipe->files hits zero, the function returns while inode->i_lock (taken at line 796) is still held; spin_unlock at line 802 is skipped. Every final put (pipe_release, fifo_open error, create_pipe_files failure) leaks the spinlock and later i_lock users deadlock.

free_pipe_info() now runs under inode->i_lock. It calls watch_queue_clear, pipe_buf_release, free_uid, __free_page, and kfree, which can sleep or take sleeping locks. The pre-patch code only set a kill flag under the lock and freed after spin_unlock.
